scientific_integrity: Proof includes signed-measure reduction, beta-prime representation and a moderate-deviation argument. Finite numerical consistency tests are supporting, not infinite verification.
scientific_limitations: The exact finite formula is a supremum, with no general claim of actual attainment or a unique winning cell. The limit laws concern a fixed observation window and the classical negative-binomial point-sampling operator; they do not cover integral variants. Historical priority remains qualified by incompletely available older source texts.
title: Sharp integrated BV error and a logarithmic boundary layer for Baskakov sampling
